name: Rukhsanah L. Singh
service_line_reviewed: Service reviewed: Appointed March 16, 2022 through September 13, 2026. Selected decisions: 4.

biography.text: Singh earned a B.A. from Davidson College and a J.D. from Seton Hall University School of Law. She clerked for U.S. District Judge Joel A. Pisano and New Jersey Supreme Court Justice Roberto A. Rivera-Soto, practiced at Connell Foley, served as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in the Eastern District of New York’s Civil Division, and was assistant general counsel for litigation at BASF.
